title: 第18章 丰龙股份重大利好，借壳上市？
novel_title: 县城：女友出国要我卖房，给脸了
content_zh:
李西海跟李西朋安静的听着。

    没有打断倾诉，也没有讲大道理什么的。

    李西雄这事，谁都不好说什么。

    毕竟是人家的家务事。

    正说着，李西英到了。

    他长得很魁梧，是水产海鲜批发市场的一霸，没什么人敢惹他的。

    见到李西雄絮絮叨叨的，冷着脸坐下来，拿起开了的啤酒，就怼了一瓶。

    “老三，你也真好意思。”

    “我们亲兄弟，你也骗我。”

    李西海与李西朋：“？”

    “英哥，雄哥骗你啥了？”李西朋问道。

    “他说要投资什么东西，手头没钱，从我这里借了十几万去。”

    李西英说着就朝着李西雄手臂上拍了一巴掌，骂道：“他尼玛，结果是拿去填股市窟窿的。”

    “啊？”

    李西海跟李西朋都傻眼了。

    “嫂子知道吗？”李西朋问道。

    “都不知道，这事我都没敢说。”

    李西英骂道：“西雄，你特么是个人啊？”

    “我这么相信你，你都要骗我。”

    “爸妈要是知道，不把姐叫回来收拾你？”

    李西海知道李西英，李西雄两兄弟，最怕的就是他们姐姐。

    小时候，大伯大娘忙着生意，没时间照顾，就把两兄弟交给姐姐带。

    可以说从小就是李西惠带大的。

    哪怕是三十出头，还是活在阴影下。

    李西海都有点怕李西惠这个堂姐。

    她是真的拿藤条抽人的。

    “回来就回来，我不怕她。”

    李西雄嘟囔道，但声调没那么高了。

    “现在这事闹的。”

    李西英无奈的说道：“你媳妇也回娘家了。”

    “股市的事，你准备怎么办，继续头铁下去？”

    李西雄道：“哥，我不甘心，亏了十几万，说走就走，我……。”

    他抓住李西英的手，“哥，亲哥，你要支持我，坚定的支持我。”

    “大不了以后，我请你洗脚，豁出去给你打掩护。”

    “亲哥啊……。”

    李西英又气又笑，想了想，道：“亏十几万没什么，别把家庭给闹得不可开交。”

    “家里不缺这点钱，只是……。”

    他看向李西海跟李西朋，道：“这种一声不吭的性质，很沙比。”
content_en:
Li Xihai and Li Xipeng listened quietly.

    He didn’t interrupt the conversation, and he didn’t make excuses or anything like that.

    It's hard for anyone to say anything about Li Xixiong.

    After all, it is a family matter.

    Just as he was talking, Li Xiying arrived.

    He is very burly and is the dominant player in the seafood wholesale market. No one dares to mess with him.

    Seeing Li Xixiong chattering, he sat down with a cold face, picked up the opened beer, and drank a bottle.

    "Third brother, you are so kind."

    "We are brothers, and you lied to me too."

    Li Xihai and Li Xipeng: "?"

    "Brother Ying, what did Brother Xiong lie to you about?" Li Xipeng asked.

    "He said he wanted to invest in something. He had no money on hand, so he borrowed hundreds of thousands from me."

    As she spoke, Li Xiying slapped Li Xixiong on the arm and cursed: "Damn it, it turned out to be used to fill the hole in the stock market."

    "Huh?"

    Li Xihai and Li Xipeng were both dumbfounded.

    "Does sister-in-law know?" Li Xipeng asked.

    "I don't even know, I don't even dare to say anything about it."

    Li Xiying scolded: "Xixiong, are you a human being?"

    "I trust you so much that you have to lie to me."

    "If your parents knew about it, wouldn't they call me back to deal with you?"

    Li Xihai knew that the two brothers Li Xiying and Li Xixiong were most afraid of their sister.

    When they were young, the aunt and uncle were busy with business and had no time to take care of them, so they left the two brothers to be taken care of by their elder sister.

    It can be said that Li Xihui brought him up since he was a child.

    Even in his early thirties, he still lives in the shadows.

    Li Xihai is a little afraid of his cousin Li Xihui.

    She really whipped people with canes.

    "Come back as soon as you come back, I'm not afraid of her."

    Li Xixiong muttered, but his tone was not so high.

    "Now this is a big deal."

    Li Xiying said helplessly: "Your wife has also returned to her parents' home."

    "What are you going to do about the stock market, continue to be stubborn?"

    Li Xixiong said: "Brother, I'm not willing to give in. I've lost hundreds of thousands, so I'm leaving as soon as I say. I..."

    He grabbed Li Xiying's hand and said, "Brother, dear brother, you have to support me and support me firmly."

    "In the worst case, I'll ask you to wash your feet and risk everything to protect you."

    "Brother..."

    Li Xiying laughed angrily, thought for a while, and said: "It's nothing to lose more than a hundred thousand, don't make the family a mess."

    "The family is not short of money, but..."

    He looked at Li Xihai and Li Xipeng and said, "This kind of silence is very Shabi."
title_en: Chapter 18 Fenglong Co., Ltd. has major benefits, backdoor listing?
